content_sections.heading: Bank of Baroda Professionals Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Bank of Baroda has released for recruitment of 837 professionals on fixed-term contractual engagement in the Wealth Management Services Department. The official 24-page notification contains position-wise and category-wise vacancies, age criteria, education and professional certification requirements, work experience, application fees, remuneration provisions, selection procedure, online application instructions and detailed job responsibilities. Official Notification PDF:

content_sections.heading: Bank of Baroda Professionals Vacancy 2026 - 837 Posts
content_sections.text: Bank of Baroda has announced 837 contractual positions in its Wealth Management Services Department . Of these, 791 vacancies are for Senior Relationship Manager under the Deputy Manager designation. Vacancy Clarification: Senior Relationship Manager and Deputy Manager refer to the same advertised position and designation in this notification. They are not separate vacancy categories. The 791 openings are included within the total of 837. The notification identifies 35 vacancies under the horizontal reservation provisions for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) , including 32 in the Senior Relationship Manager category. The remaining three PwBD provisions are distributed across Group Head and Territory Head positions. The applicable disability categories and post suitability conditions are specified in the official notification. Important: PwBD reservations are horizontal and are included within the advertised 837 vacancies. They must not be added separately to the total. The number of advertised vacancies is provisional and may be revised by the Bank.

content_sections.heading: Bank of Baroda Professionals Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a graduation degree from a recognized university or institution , along with the required professional certifications and post-qualification experience for their selected position. The minimum relevant experience ranges from three years for Senior Relationship Manager to twelve years for Group Head. Experience must be relevant to the advertised wealth management, investment advisory, portfolio management or financial services responsibilities. Applicants must also satisfy the detailed employer, certification and role-specific requirements in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Bank of Baroda Senior Relationship Manager Recruitment 2026 - 791 Posts
content_sections.text: The Senior Relationship Manager (Deputy Manager) position accounts for 791 of the 837 advertised vacancies. Candidates must be graduates with the prescribed certification and at least three years of relevant post-qualification experience. Candidates must have at least three years of post-qualification experience as a Relationship Manager in Wealth Management, Investment Advisory or Portfolio Management. The experience may be with eligible organizations such as: Public Sector Banks. Private Sector Banks. Foreign Banks. Broking Firms. Securities Firms. Asset Management Companies. Other relevant Financial Services organizations. Important: Experience in a clerical cadre, teaching or training is not counted for determining the prescribed eligibility. The Bank also excludes post-qualification employment periods of less than six months in an organization when calculating experience. The notification lists the following preferred qualifications: Two-year full-time postgraduate degree or diploma in Management. MBA in Finance, Marketing or Banking. Certified Financial Planner (CFP). Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) or equivalent qualification. NISM XIII and NISM Series XXI-A certifications. Qualification Clarification: An MBA is preferred, not mandatory, for the Senior Relationship Manager position. However, graduation alone is insufficient because the prescribed professional certification and work experience are mandatory. Selected candidates will manage customer relationships, support wealth management business growth and provide appropriate investment solutions to clients. Acquire and manage affluent, High Net Worth Individual (HNI) and other wealth management customers. Build and maintain long-term client relationships. Increase Assets Under Management (AUM) and investment product business. Understand customer financial goals and investment requirements. Promote suitable mutual fund, insurance, portfolio management and other investment products. Conduct customer portfolio reviews and financial planning discussions. Support business development and customer retention. Maintain customer service, documentation and regulatory compliance standards.

content_sections.heading: Bank of Baroda Professionals Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Bank of Baroda has not published a fixed monthly salary or CTC for the five advertised WMS positions . Remuneration will be determined based on the candidate's educational qualifications, work experience, overall suitability, last-drawn salary and market benchmarks for the respective positions. Salary Clarification: Deputy Manager and Assistant Vice President are position designations in this contractual recruitment. Candidates should not assume that the regular Bank of Baroda officer pay scales apply to these appointments.

content_sections.heading: Is Bank of Baroda WMS Recruitment 2026 Permanent or Contractual?
content_sections.text: The positions are offered through fixed-term contractual engagement , initially for five years from the candidate's joining date. The contract will normally end on its expiry date unless renewed or extended. Even with an extension, the engagement cannot continue beyond the maximum age of 60 years or the applicable contract end date, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: Bank of Baroda WMS Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee is Rs. 850 for UR, EWS and OBC candidates , while SC, ST, PwBD, eligible Ex-Servicemen and women candidates must pay Rs. 175. Payment Mode: Online through the payment gateway using the available Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking or other supported payment methods. The fee amounts include GST, but applicable payment gateway charges are additional. Fees are non-refundable, even if the Bank does not conduct an online examination or a candidate is not shortlisted.

content_sections.heading: Bank of Baroda Professionals Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection may include application scrutiny, online examination, psychometric assessment, other suitable tests and personal interview , as decided by Bank of Baroda. Application Scrutiny: Applications are reviewed against the relevant qualifications, experience, certifications and other criteria. Online Test, If Conducted: Candidates may undergo an online examination if the Bank includes it in the selection process. Psychometric Assessment: The Bank may assess personality, communication, problem-solving and suitability. Personal Interview: Shortlisted applicants may be called for an interview. Document Verification: Original certificates and experience documents will be checked. Final Selection: Candidates will be selected according to the applicable assessment results, eligibility and vacancies. Important: The notification does not confirm that every candidate will appear for every assessment stage. The Bank may change or modify its selection procedure according to recruitment requirements. The Bank reserves the right to modify the interview qualifying criteria. Candidates who do not secure the applicable minimum interview marks will not be considered for the final merit list. An online examination may be conducted, but it is not confirmed as a compulsory stage for every advertised WMS position . The notification does not provide a fixed question count, syllabus, examination duration or marking scheme for this recruitment. Candidates should check the official Bank of Baroda careers page for any subsequent examination announcement.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Bank of Baroda Professionals Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload documents supporting their educational qualification, professional certification, experience, identity and applicable reservation claims. Current resume or bio-data. Class 10 certificate or other accepted date-of-birth proof. Graduation degree certificate and marksheets. Postgraduate management qualification certificate, where claimed. Relevant NISM, IRDA, CFP or CFA certificates. Employment and experience certificates. Appointment letters and relieving letters, where applicable. Latest salary slips and documents showing CTC breakup. Valid photo identity proof. SC/ST/OBC/EWS certificates, where applicable. PwBD certificate, where applicable. Ex-Servicemen service or discharge documents, where applicable. No Objection Certificate for applicable currently employed candidates at the required verification stage. Recent passport-size photograph. Scanned signature. Other certificates requested by the Bank during application or selection. Original eligibility documents and self-attested copies must be produced when called for interview or document verification. Failure to produce the relevant certificates may result in rejection. All educational certificates should be scanned into one PDF file as instructed in Annexure II. The photograph must be recent, in colour and clearly show the candidate's face. The signature must be made on white paper with black ink.
